units.source_text: 且说内大臣去后，近江君对五节君说：

en.t: After the Minister of the Interior had gone, Omi no Kimi said to Gosechi no Kimi:

units.source_text: “爹爹叫我去拜访女御，我倘逡巡不前，

en.t: Father has told me to pay a visit to the lady consort, and if I hesitate and hold back,

units.source_text: 生怕女御生气，我今夜就去吧。

en.t: I am afraid the lady consort will be angry, so I had better go tonight.

units.source_text: 即使爹爹把我当作盖世无双的宝贝，

en.t: Even if Father treats me as a treasure without equal in all the world,

units.source_text: 但倘女御等看我不起，我在这邸内便站不住脚了。”

en.t: if the lady consort and the others look down on me, I will have no place to stand in this mansion.

units.source_text: 可见内大臣对她的关怀很浅。

en.t: This shows how little real care the Minister of the Interior had shown for her.

units.source_text: 她先写一封信送给女御，信中写道：

en.t: First she wrote a letter and sent it to the lady consort, saying:

units.source_text: “相处甚近，‘只隔疏篱’，‘似形随影’，

en.t: Though we live so near, separated only by a thin fence and as close as form and shadow,

units.source_text: 而迄今未得拜访，莫非有‘谁设勿来关’乎？

en.t: I have still not been able to visit you. Can it be that someone has set up a barrier forbidding me to come?

units.source_text: 不胜遗憾。

en.t: I regret it more than I can say.

units.source_text: 虽未拜见尊颜，但正如‘不识武藏野，闻名亦可爱’，

en.t: Although I have not yet had the honor of seeing your face, just as one may love Musashino by reputation without knowing it,

units.source_text: 因我二人有似同根之紫草也。

en.t: the two of us seem like purple grasses growing from the same root.

units.source_text: 以此比拟，能勿冒渎乎？

en.t: Would it be too presumptuous for me to make such a comparison?

units.source_text: 诚惶诚恐，诚惶诚恐！”

en.t: I am deeply awed and fearful, deeply awed and fearful!

units.source_text: 字中的点子写得很长。

en.t: The dots in her writing were drawn out very long.

units.source_text: 反面又写道：

en.t: On the back she had written again:

units.source_text: “诚然，今夜定当趋前叩晤，

en.t: Indeed, tonight I shall certainly come forward and pay my respects to you,

units.source_text: 此亦所谓‘越憎爱越深’乎？

en.t: is this also what people mean when they say that the more one resents, the deeper love becomes?

units.source_text: 怪哉，怪哉，思慕之情，

en.t: How strange, how strange, this feeling of longing,

units.source_text: ‘犹似川底涸，地下有泉通’也。”

en.t: it is like a riverbed that seems dry while a spring still runs beneath the ground.

units.source_text: 上端又题着一首诗：

en.t: At the top she had also written a poem:
